title: March of the Machine: The Aftermath | She Who Breaks the World
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf animist who has lost her spark and her connection to the planes after being compleated; she buries her Phyrexian carapace and mends her bond with Chandra.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who promises to find Ajani, then returns to apologize and learn to give Nissa room.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker whose spark has faded and who offers Nissa a home in Zhalfir.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem who helps build the new village and fights the lightning beast.

entities.name: Koth of the Hammer
entities.description: A Mirran who helps build the new village and warns of protecting their new home.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who still has his spark and has gone missing; Chandra goes to find him.

entities.name: Wrenn
aliases: the sprout that used to be Wrenn
entities.description: A dryad now regrown as a fast-growing sprout on a hill above the village, nurtured by Zhalfir's suns.

entities.name: Ashaya
entities.description: The elemental Worldsoul of Zendikar.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Chandra says she once loved.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Chandra says she loved.

entities.name: Storm elemental
entities.description: A lightning-veined predator from another plane that emerges from a portal, attacks the village and is finally dissolved into rain.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who compleated Nissa and defeated.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The alliance of planeswalkers to which Nissa and Chandra belonged.

entities.name: Zhalfirins and Mirrans
entities.description: The villagers and warriors of the new village who defend it from the beast.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: The plane where the survivors live and which at first does not answer Nissa.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nissa's homeworld, whose song she hears faintly through the portal.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The plane whose five suns now shine in Zhalfir's sky.

entities.name: The portal
entities.description: A blue rift on the hill that the storm creature emerges from and that hums with Zendikar's leyline song.

entities.name: Phyrexian carapace
entities.description: Nissa's cast-off copper Phyrexian skeleton, which Chandra melts and buries.

entities.name: Stem Sword
entities.description: Nissa's staff-and-sword weapon, cleansed of oil.

entities.name: The sylex
entities.description: The device whose detonation in the Blind Eternities may have punched holes between planes and caused sparks to fade.

entities.name: Invasion Tree
entities.description: The Phyrexian tree Nissa spoke Phyrexia's glory through and Wrenn bound herself to.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes into which the sylex exploded.

entities.name: Spark
entities.description: The planeswalker's power that has faded for Nissa, Teferi and Koth.

events.summary: Nissa digs a grave at night in Zhalfir, wondering whether she lost her spark; her friends say Teferi's and Koth's sparks have faded too.
events.quote: is this what happens when a Planeswalker loses her spark?

events.summary: Nissa tries to feel Zhalfir but the plane does not answer, and she feels cut off from the Multiverse as the others settle in the new village.
events.quote: But Zhalfir still never spoke to her.

events.summary: Chandra helps Nissa melt her Phyrexian carapace and bury it, and reveals she will leave the next day to find Ajani.
Nissa asks what kind of love Chandra has for her and, hurt by her answer, tells her to go; Chandra leaves.
events.quote: "Then be clear—exactly what kind of love do you have for me?"

events.summary: Nissa tries to meditate beside the sprout of Wrenn but her connection to the Multiverse is smothered by the voices of those who touched her mind, and she collapses in pain.
A blue rift tears open and a lightning-veined beast bursts out, forcing Nissa to fight it alone and without her magic or leylines.
events.quote: The beast is like nothing she has seen before

events.summary: Nissa fails to summon an elemental and is thrown by the beast; Teferi freezes it and Karn holds it before it escapes.
events.quote: She sees Teferi, staff outstretched, his radiant, blue spell holding the beast in place.

events.summary: The group studies the portal; Nissa hears faint Zendikar in it and the others advise caution and a hunt for the creature first.
The beast returns and ransacks the village; Nissa leads it away with roots.
events.quote: Slowly, vine by vine, swing by swing, Nissa leads the creature out of the village.

events.summary: Chandra arrives and fights the beast with fire, but her fireballs boil a baobab and make it grow colossal, forcing them into a pit.
events.quote: Chandra pushes Nissa out of the way of its snapping jaws

events.summary: Trapped, Nissa confronts Chandra about her broken promise, and Chandra apologizes, saying she still wants to know her.
events.quote: "But I still want to know you."

events.summary: Chandra tells Nissa that her connections are changing her voice into something more powerful; Nissa calls to Zhalfir in a chorus and the plane forgives her.
Nissa realizes the creature is a storm elemental from another plane and channels Zhalfir's power into Chandra to heat it into steam and rain.
events.quote: Chandra pours heat and energy into the creature.

events.summary: Floating in the flood, Chandra explains her love and promises to give Nissa room; they kiss.
events.quote: Nissa pulls Chandra into a kiss.

events.summary: After celebrating, Nissa and Chandra step through the portal together, hoping to find Zendikar.
events.quote: Hand in hand, Chandra and Nissa step through the portal into just one of infinite possibilities.

relations.note: They kiss and commit to each other
relations.quote: Nissa pulls Chandra into a kiss.

relations.note: Nissa says Chandra finally kissed her

relations.quote: "You will have a new home here if you just try."

relations.note: Karn and Koth helped cut her out of her metal prison
relations.quote: They cut her out of her metal prison

relations.note: Her connection to the Phyrexians still haunts her
relations.quote: part of her misses hearing those planes.

relations.note: Nissa feels kinship with the sprout of Wrenn
relations.quote: she feels a unique kinship with the only other Planeswalker who bound herself to the Invasion Tree.
If I can't bring him back, who can?

relations.note: Nissa was a member before leaving and returning
relations.quote: before she joined the Gatewatch, before she met Chandra
She can't let it near the village.

relations.note: Koth helps her up and returns her weapon
relations.quote: Koth is back on his feet, sliding his arm under Nissa to help her up.
